**Article Details for PMID: 42933461**

**Title:** Izalontamab brengitecan versus platinum-based chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated advanced non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer after progression on third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (PANKU-Lung01): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial in China.

**Authors:** Shaodong Hong, Ting Zhou, Xue Hou, Xiangjiao Meng, Zhihuang Hu, Wei Zheng, Jiuwei Cui, Yongzhong Luo, Lin Wu, Meijuan Huang, Haipeng Xu, Jie Hu, Yanqiu Zhao, Wenxiu Yao, Yonggui Hong, Jun Cai, Yu Zhang, Chunxia Su, Conghua Xie, Ruoyu Wang, Xiang Li, Qiong He, Liang Zhang, Ruiling Ning, Daren Lin, Tongmei Zhang, Tienan Yi, Liqiang Zhong, Siyuan Huang, Hui Zhao, Jian Fang, Qing Bu, Bihui Li, Zhiye Zhang, Meiqi Shi, Jianhua Shi, Zhiping Deng, Yi Zhu, Hai Zhu, Sa Xiao, Lei Yang, Ni Song, Wenfeng Fang, Li Zhang, Yunpeng Yang, PANKU-Lung01 Investigators

**Journal:** Lancet (London, England)
**Publication Date:** 2026-10-26
**DOI:** 10.1016/S0140-6736(26)02026-X

**Abstract:**
Izalontamab brengitecan (iza-bren) is a first-in-class bispecific antibody-drug conjugate targeting epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and human epidermal growth factor receptor 3 (HER3) and has shown antitumour activity in EGFR-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). We compared iza-bren with platinum-based chemotherapy in participants with EGFR-mutated advanced non-squamous NSCLC after progression on third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs).
